c.tagline: Motor City reborn - Motown, techno, Art Deco towers, and a riverfront rising.

taxi.fareNote: Street cabs are uncommon; most visitors rely on Uber and Lyft, which are widely available across the metro area.

emergency.note: 911 is the single emergency number for police, fire, and ambulance.

english.label: Easy to get by in English

avoid.reason: Downtown/Midtown revitalized and safe; many outer neighborhoods high-crime — stay central

hood_desc: The revitalized core around Campus Martius Park, with skyscrapers, sports arenas, casinos, and the riverfront; the most convenient and walkable base for a first Detroit visit.
Detroit's cultural heart, home to the Detroit Institute of Arts, the Charles H. Wright Museum, Wayne State University, and a growing dining scene; ideal for museum-goers and culture seekers.

Detroit's oldest neighborhood, now its trendiest, with Michigan Central Station's grand revival, buzzing bars, farm-to-table restaurants, and vintage shops; suits hip travelers who want character and nightlife.
A compact entertainment strip of Greek restaurants, a casino, and bars beside the historic district; lively day and night and popular with visitors who want dining and gaming within walking distance.
A quieter, architecturally rich area anchored by the Art Deco Fisher Building and the original Motown Museum (Hitsville U.S.A.); good for those who want history and calm just north of the action.
lodging: Aloft Detroit at The David Whitney

water.note: Tap water is safe to drink and meets federal standards.

transit.pay: Buy a DART card or use the DART mobile app to ride DDOT and SMART buses; the base bus fare is $2.00 and a DART day pass is $5. The QLINE streetcar along Woodward Avenue and the downtown People Mover both currently run fare-free.
transit.hours: DDOT runs 24 hours on several core routes; the QLINE runs roughly 6am to midnight (later on weekends), and the People Mover runs from morning until around midnight.

air: Coleman A. Young International Airport (DET, general aviation)
train: Detroit Amtrak Station (New Center, Wolverine line)

transit.m: SMART FAST Michigan bus to downtown Detroit (~45-60 min)

tip.r: ~15-20% is standard at restaurants; round up for taxis and tip $1-2 per drink at bars.
